verdict.rationale: Bruno is an offline-only desktop app with no cloud sync, account or login, and collections are stored as files on the user's own filesystem, so the core product runs entirely on user-controlled machines. The CLI also ships as official Docker images for running on your own infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit open-source license or build-from-source documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of fully self-contained deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.
No cloud sync. No account. No login.
Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem.
Official Docker images for the Bruno CLI let you run API collections in CI/CD pipelines and locally without installing Node.js or npm on the host.
Available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
